title: Country box sends getCountries on every open, even when the list is loaded
trigger: Open the shipping/poll/card country box with the list already loaded
effect: A redundant getCountries request each open; the box has no loaded/failed gate
fix: Ask only when auth_state.countries is Idle/Failed (Fetch<T> already says which)

title: A queued link is taken from its slot before the send; a failed send drops it with no note
trigger: Click a t.me link while the driver send fails (native error) after auth Ready
effect: Nothing happens: no flow, no error note, link is gone
fix: Keep the link until the send returns a RequestId, or show an error note on Err

title: Join on the invite box takes invite_box before the send and ignores the send error
effect: The box closes, no join and no error; the preview stays as session flow stage
fix: Close the box only on Ok(Some(request)); show the error otherwise

title: Linked media timestamp seek is an Option of (chat,message,seconds,Instant deadline) polled from upkeep
trigger: Open a t.me link with a media timestamp; the message loads late or never
effect: Deadline only evaluated when upkeep runs; the slot is session-wide with a bare ChatId, not owned by account/window
fix: A MediaSeek stage owned by the chat window holding a Task with the deadline, dropped with the chat

title: Device link stage is held twice: DeviceLink::Linking(RequestId) in privacy and DeviceLogin::Waiting{request} in the session
trigger: Link a device by QR; the request id is copied into the UI enum and the session's DeviceLogin
effect: No bug today; the UI Linking stage ends only when poll_device_qr takes the session result, so a result the session discards without answering leaves Linking (busy) until an account switch
fix: One owner: keep the Waiting request in DeviceLogin and let the UI read it (or hold only the UI enum and have the session keep an answer slot)
